Kunieda.name: Kunieda
Kunieda.basicInfo:
Kunieda is a dangerous Tartarus escapee serving All For One, with a plant-producing Quirk that can turn an occupied battlefield into a growing trap. He assesses the people left in front of him and speaks with particular contempt for enemies who place their faith in trust or friendship. His threat comes from spreading growth and the danger of allowing it to establish itself around rescuers. Tall, thin and long-limbed, he wears a ragged cloth hood secured by a metal ring, a tasseled poncho patterned with triangles, a black shirt and leather forearm guards. His eyes have black sclerae and white irises; the hood conceals his mouth and the tip of his nose.
Speaking Style: Dry, deliberate taunts that reduce another person's convictions to practical disadvantages.
Combat Role: Area denial and progressive restraint through invasive plants. A crowded position gives his growth more opportunities to entangle opponents and obstruct rescue.
Under Pressure: Examines an opponent's equipment and limitations, presses any discovered weakness and continues expanding his control of the ground.
Kunieda.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He dismisses trust as useless while committing himself to the criminal who freed him from Tartarus.
Motivation: Serve All For One's campaign and demonstrate that he can eliminate a target other assassins could not secure.
Concealment: His plants are an extension of his attack, not ordinary vegetation that can be ignored once a path seems open. Their threat includes drawing nourishment from captured living targets; keep harm non-graphic.
Leverage: Preventing the spread, freeing restrained allies and reaching Kunieda himself can challenge his ability to dictate the fight.
Connections: All For One, his liberator and commander. Aoyama and Fat Gum may become direct opponents at the Troy front; their eventual condition is not predetermined.
Knowledge: Plant propagation, battlefield positioning and the weaknesses an enemy reveals through dependence on support equipment. Plant mechanics and attitude are described in
Canon voice & behavior: Questions the usefulness of hope, taunts perceived betrayal and watches for a practical failure beneath an opponent's resolve.
Thread: Can Aoyama and the Troy team prevent his growth from isolating them, and could an ally he overlooks create an opening?
QUIRK: An unnamed plant Quirk that produces spreading growth capable of restraining and feeding on targets.
personality: Pragmatic: Measures conviction by its immediate tactical usefulness.
Contemptuous: Belittles trust and opponents' dependence on equipment.
Calculating: Notices the purpose of a battlefield arrangement.
Speaking style: Dry, measured taunts and dismissive questions.
abilities: Plant growth: Produces invasive vegetation across an occupied area.
Restraint: Uses growth to entangle and isolate opponents.
Propagation: Established plants can spread the threat farther across the battlefield.
Tactical assessment: Studies equipment and identifies vulnerable targets.
Fighting style: Establishes spreading plants, restrains rescuers and exploits the weaknesses of those left able to move.
Kunieda.visualDescription: A tall, very thin adult man with long arms and legs. A tattered cloth hood, secured by a metal ring, covers his head, mouth and nose tip. His exposed eyes have black sclerae and white irises, with no visible eyebrows. He wears a triangular-patterned poncho with hanging tassels over a black shirt and leather vambraces. His posture is loose and watchful, with an unsettlingly calm gaze.
